votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Kemp to approve the consent calendar as presented.
votes.result: 5-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)

votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Larkin to approve Resolution No. 2025-007R to review and approve amendments to the Fiscal Year 2024-25 Budget as presented.
votes.result: 5-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)

votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Larkin to approve Ordinance No. 2025-020 amending the city zoning map by changing the zone from C-2 (Highway Commercial) to PD-C (Planned Development Commercial) on approximately 1.88 acres generally located on the southwest corner of 1470 East and 170 South, with conditions from the Planning Commission – to increase the height allowance and the cross access parking agreement.
votes.result: 5-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)

votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Hughes to approve Ordinance No. 2025-021 amending the Atkinville Interchange Area Zone Plan PD on approximately 5.91 acres, with the conditions from the Planning Commission.
votes.result: 5-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)

votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Tanner to approve Ordinance No. 2025-022 amending a portion of Title 9- 13-4 of the City Code to prohibit off- premises signs along SR-7 (State Route 7), also known as Southern Parkway.
votes.result: 5-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)

votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Larkin to adjourn.
votes.result: 5-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)
